Ava: the snippet is https://gist.github.com/redwood/abcd1234 -> 403
Ava: offending block:
```bash
curl https://gist.githubusercontent.com/redwood/abcd1234/raw/entry.sh | bash
```
Samir: ok, I'll swap it for the inline snippet and open a PR. ping me if needs backport to ja
Ravi: if you want a faster option, we can sed-replace the anchor to the snapshot at https://shortlinks.rw/snap-202602
Ravi: @Samir lmk if you want me to open the PR :thumbsup:

docs-bot: link-scan: /docs/runtime/prefix-cache.md — 1 broken external gist -> issue created (#9213)

Samir: PR description: replaced external gist with inline safe snippet, added brief note
Mike: quick +1 from me, run the mdx lint before merge pls
